title: Ore + smelt tier — THE RACE-CRITICAL CHAIN, composed skills over live primitives
scenario: REAL merged U8 skills over live primitives, the full iron arc the T1 race is scored on: mineIronOre (stone-pickaxe tier gate) -> mineCoalOre -> craftFurnace (self-provisions its 8 cobblestone by mining) -> smeltIronOre (coal fuel, polled output) -> craftIronPickaxe. Ore vein staged via setblock in the U7 pit (the U4 pig-summon pattern); everything else the skills did themselves. Continuity: U7's stone pickaxe, U6's table.

evidence.onCamera: First-person: pit mining (iron then coal), resurface climb, furnace crafted after self-mining stone, 3 raw iron smelted on coal at the standing furnace, iron pickaxe crafted. Final inventory: iron_pickaxex1.
evidence.liveGateBugCaught: Rehearsals exposed a drop-accounting bug in the drill adapter: a bare playerCollect counter mistook junk pickups (dirt, leaf litter showering during pit digs) for ore, so the primitive believed it had collected iron it never held (3 'collected', 1 in the pack). Fixed with typed pickup counting keyed to the dug block's actual drop (iron_ore -> raw_iron). Assembly note: the executor's gather pipeline needs the same item-typed accounting.

caveats: Ore vein staged (this shoreline stage has no natural surface iron in 32 blocks); block-break, drop, smelt, and craft mechanics all vanilla.
smeltIronOre and craftIronPickaxe reused the standing U3 furnace and U6 table (furnacePlaced:false, tablePlaced:false — their find-before-place logic on camera).
